## Purpose
Write RED (failing) behavioral tests for the comment_response phase before implementing it.

## Tests to write (tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-comment-response.sh)

### Test 1: _ALL_PHASES includes comment_response
Given: merge-to-main-direct.sh is loaded in library mode (MERGE_TO_MAIN_DIRECT_LIB=1)
When: grep for comment_response in _ALL_PHASES
Then: comment_response appears in the array

### Test 2: --resume from pre-comment_response state file exits 0 and runs comment_response
Given: a state file that has completed_phases=["sync","merge","version_bump","validate","push","archive","ci_trigger"] but NOT comment_response
When: merge-to-main-direct.sh --resume is invoked with the state file present and _phase_comment_response stubbed to exit 0
Then: exits 0, does not error or silently skip comment_response

### Test 3: comment_response phase writes phase to state file
Given: a stub _phase_comment_response implementation
When: the phase runs
Then: state file records comment_response in current_phase or phases dict

## Files to modify
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-comment-response.sh (CREATE NEW)

## Testing mode
RED — tests must FAIL before implementation (no _phase_comment_response exists yet)

## Notes
- Source merge-to-main-direct.sh with MERGE_TO_MAIN_DIRECT_LIB=1 to get _ALL_PHASES
- Use mktemp for state files, never hardcoded paths
- Follow behavioral testing standard: no grep on source code, no existence-only assertions
data.title: RED: Behavioral tests for _phase_comment_response state tracking and resume
